# REST API: Catalog

These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/tables`

List the tables you may read, across environments and namespaces

Filtered by environment, namespace, model kind and a search text, sorted and paged by a cursor. What you may not read is left out, not refused: each table needs `READ_TABLE` on it, a list writes no `AUTHORIZATION_DENIED`, and no count of hidden tables is given. Every table shows its owner's name and kind, when it was last read and by how many principals in the last 7 UTC days (never who), and its health in one word. A table with no known value for the sort key comes last. A search text matches the same texts as the environment search, only in tables you may read; `capped` says it stopped early, at 5,000 readable candidates, so narrow it. Answers 404 when `environment` does not exist (to someone who may read environments; anyone else gets an empty page, as for one that exists), and 422 for a `sort`, `order`, `limit`, `q`, `model_kind`, `lang` or `cursor` that is not valid.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | query | no | text or null | Only this environment. |
| `namespace` | query | no | text or null | Only this namespace and the ones beneath it, dotted. |
| `q` | query | no | text or null | Only tables whose name, label, description, grain, or a column's name, label, description or measure contains this text; 1 to 200 characters. |
| `model_kind` | query | no | text or null | Only tables whose asset header declares this kind: fact, dimension, wide or staging. |
| `sort` | query | no | text | What the list is sorted by: name, owner, health, rows, size, last_write, last_read, created. A table with no value sorts last, in either order. |
| `order` | query | no | text or null | asc or desc; by default asc for name, owner and health, desc for the rest. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Tables per page, 1 to 200. |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page, sent with the same filters and sort. |
| `lang` | query | no | text or null | The language of the texts, such as de or fr-CH; without it, your profile's language, then Accept-Language, then the instance's main language. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `TableListPageOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `TableListPageOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `TableListItemOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |
| `capped` | true or false | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/tables/tree`

Count the tables you may read, by environment and namespace

A node's count is what the list answers for it without a search text: only tables you may read are counted, an environment is shown with `READ_ENVIRONMENT` or a readable table in it, a namespace with `READ_NAMESPACE` on its environment or a readable table in it or beneath it. Writes no audit event.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `TableTreeOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `TableTreeOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | whole number | yes |  |
| `environments` | list of `TreeEnvironmentOut` | yes |  |
